questions.question: A family has an annual income of Rs. 8,00,000, out of which they save some money. They spend 15% of the total income on health. The expenditure done on education is half of the expenditure incurred on rent. The expenditure on food was Rs. 40,000, which is 10% of the expenditure on rent. How much money (in Rs.) is saved?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A family has an annual income of Rs. 8,00,000

They spend 15% of the total income on health

The expenditure done on education is half of the expenditure incurred on rent

The expenditure on food was Rs. 40,000, which is 10% of the expenditure on rent

**Concept Used:**

A percentage is a number or ratio that can be expressed as a fraction of 100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

⇒ 10% of rent = 40000

⇒ 100%= Rs. 400000

Expenditure on rent = Rs. 40,000

⇒ Expenditure on education = (Expenditure on rent)/(2)=(400000)/(2) =Rs. 200000

⇒ Expenditure on health = 15% of total income = 800000times(15)/(100)=Rs. 120000

⇒ Total expenditure= 400000 + 200000 + 120000 + 40000 = Rs. 760000

⇒ Savings = Total income - Expenditure = 800000 - 760000 = Rs. 40000

**Hence, The money he saved after all the expenditures is Rs. 40000**

questions.question: A thief seeing a policeman from a distance of 550 metres started running at a speed of 9 km/h. The policeman began to chase him immediately, at a speed of 11 km/h and the thief was caught. What is the distance run by the thief before he was caught by the policeman?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **Speed of policeman = 11 km/h, speed of thief = 9 km/h, distance between thief and policeman = 550 m

**To find:-** The distance run by the thief before getting caught

**Formula used:- Distance = speed × time**

**Calculations:-** The distance covered by thief before getting caught is distance** 'd' m**

So, the total distance travelled by the policeman = **(550 + d) m**

The total time taken by the policeman to cover (550 + d) and the thief to covered d will be same, let's say **t**

The **speed of policeman** = 11km/h = 11times(5)/(18)m/s , the **speed of thief** = 9km/h = 9times(5)/(18) m/s

⇒Time taken by policeman (**t**) = ((550+d))/((frac{55){18})} = (18times(550+d))/(55) ------------------(i)

⇒Time taken by thief (**t**) = ((d))/((frac{45){18})} = (18d)/(45)--------------------------------------(ii)

**Equating both eq(i) and (ii),**

⇒(18times(550+d))/(55) = (18d)/(45)

⇒9times(550+d)=11times(d)

⇒4950 = 2d

⇒**d = 2475 m**

 

**The distance covered by the thief before getting caught is 2475 metres.**

Selling price = 100 - 20% × 100

By using the formula of % profit,

⇒(80-CP)/(CP)=(3)/(10)

⇒Cost price**(CP)= Rs. (800)/(13)**

⇒% profit without discount = (100-frac{800)/(13)}{(800)/(13)}times 100

⇒**% profit without discount = (500)/(8)**** = 62.5%**

questions.question: A can complete (3)/(5) of the work in 9 days and B can complete (1)/(5) of the work in 6 days. Working together, A and B can complete (3)/(5) of the work in __________.
questions.solution:
**Given:-** A completes (3)/(5)th of work in 9 days and B completes (1)/(5)the of work in 6 days

**To find:- **If worked together then time taken by A and B to complete (3)/(5)the of work

**Formula used:-** **Work done = Efficiency × time taken**

**Calculations:- **Let the total work be 1 unit

It is given that,

A completes the (3)/(5) of work in 9 days,

⇒Total work done by A = (3)/(5)times 1 = (3)/(5)

⇒**Efficiency of A** = (frac{3)/(5)×1}{9} = (1)/(15)

Similarly,

⇒Total work done by B = (1)/(5)times 1 = (1)/(5)

⇒**Efficiency of B** = (frac{1)/(5)×1}{6} = (1)/(30)

**When A and B works together then,**

Total efficiency of working = (1)/(15) + (1)/(30) = (1)/(10)

Total work to be done = (3)/(5)times 1 = (3)/(5)

By using the formula, Work done = Efficiency × time taken

Time taken = (work done)/(Efficiency)

⇒Time taken = ((frac{3)/(5))}{((1)/(10))} = (3)/(5)times(10)/(1)

⇒Time taken = 6 days

 

**.´. The time taken by A and B to complete the (3)/(5)** **of work is 6 days.**

questions.question: A number is cube of 53. When 7 times of 57 is subtracted from the number, then the resultant number which is formed will be divisible by:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cube of 53 subtracted by 7 times 57 

**Formula used:**

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3a²b + 3ab² , 

**Calculations:-**

Let the resultant number be '**x**',

⇒x = 53³ - 7 × 57

⇒ x = (55 - 2)³ - (7) × (55 + 2) 

⇒ x = (55³ - 8 - 3 × 55² × 2 + 3 × 55 × 2²) - 55 × 7 - 14

⇒ x = (55)³ - 6 × (55)² + 12 × (55) - 7 × (55) - 8 - 14

⇒ x = (55)3 - 6 × (55)2 + 12 × (55) - 7 × (55) - 22

⇒ x = 11[5 × (55)² - 6 × (55)2 + 12 × (55) - 7 × (55) - 22]

⇒ The common factor in resultant number is 11, hence the number is divisible by 11

**.´. The resultant number is divisible by 11.**

questions.question: The HCF of 72,108 and 360 is _______.
questions.solution:
**Given:- **Numbers are 72, 108, and 360

**To find:- **HCF(72, 108, 360)

**Concept used:-** HCF is the highest common factors of given numbers

**Calculations:-**

The prime factors of 72, 108, and 360 are:-

⇒72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3

⇒108 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 3

⇒360 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5

The highest common factors among the prime factors are:- (2 × 2 × 3 × 3)

The HCF (72, 108, 360) = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = **36**

**.´. The HCF of 72, 108, 360 is 36**

questions.question: The count of bacteria in a sample grows by 24% during the first hour.It decreases by 15% during the next one hour and again decreases by 10% during the third hour. If the present count of bacteria in the sample is 55000, then what will be the net increase/decrease in the count of bacteria after three hours?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Present count of bacteria = 55000

The count of bacteria in a sample grows by 24% during the first hour

It decreases by 15% during the next one hour

Decreases by 10% during the third hour

**Formula Used:**

Percentage= (Increasedspace value)/(Initial space value)times 100

**Calculation:**

The count of bacteria in a sample grows by 24% during the first hour

⇒ Percentage= (Increasedspace value)/(Initial space value)times 100

⇒ 24= (Increasedspace value)/(55000)times 100

⇒ Increased Value= 24 x 550= 13200

⇒ Increased Bacteria= 55000 + 13200 = 68200

It decreases by 15% during the next one hour

⇒ Percentage= (Decreasedspace value)/(Initial space value)times 100

⇒ 15= (Decreasedspace value)/(68200)times 100

⇒ Decreased Value= 15 x 682 = 10230

⇒ Decreased Bacteria= 68200 - 10230 = 57970

Decreases by 10% during the next one hour

⇒ Percentage= (Decreasedspace value)/(Initial space value)times 100

⇒ 10= (Decreasedspace value)/(57970)times 100

⇒ Decreased Value= 10 x 579.70 = 5797

⇒ Decreased Bacteria= 57970 - 5797 = 52173

⇒ Net Increased/Decreased = Increased in 1st Hour + Decreased in 2nd hour + Decreased in 3rd hour = 13200 + (-10230) + (-5797) = -2827 ( here (-) shows Decreased)

**Hence, The net Decreased in bacteria is 2827**

questions.question: A man borrowed Rs. 46,000 at 5% per annum compound interest, compounded annually. How much money (in Rs.) will he pay as interest at the end of 2 years to clear his debt?
questions.solution:
**Given:-** Borrowed money = Rs. 46,000 , Interest rate = 5% and time period = 2 years

**To find:-** Money to be paid at the end of 2 years

**Formula used:- **Amount = P(1+(r)/(100))^t, when compounded annually

**Calculations:- ** After 2 years the amount to be paid will be-

⇒Amount = 46,000times(1+(5)/(100))²

⇒Amount = 46,000times((21)/(20))²

⇒Amount = 46,000times((21)/(20)times(21)/(20)) = 115×21×21

⇒Amount = 50,715

As we know,** Amount = principal + interest**

⇒Interest = Amount - Principal

⇒Interest = 50,715 - 46,000 = Rs. 4715

 

**.´.Interest after 2 years will be Rs. 4715**

questions.question: The CP of an article is Rs. 7,000. By selling it, a person gains 10%. How much should the person sell it for to get a gain of Rs. 50 more?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial Profit = 10% of 7000 = Rs. 700

Required New Profit = Initial Profit + 50 = 700 + 50 = Rs. 750

New Selling Price = CP + New Profit = 7000 + 750 = Rs. 7750

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 7,750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 7,000

Initial Gain = 10%

Extra Gain required = Rs. 50

**Formula Used:**

Gain = (Gain% ÷ 100) × CP

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Total Gain

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53da61a5a4327175467d69931a0e5e90ba9482bb6fbc7beb60de68e27ccbec9c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial Gain = (10 ÷ 100) × 7000

⇒ Initial Gain = Rs. 700

⇒ Total Gain required = Initial Gain + 50

⇒ Total Gain = 700 + 50 = Rs. 750

⇒ New Selling Price = CP + Total Gain

⇒ New Selling Price = 7000 + 750 = Rs. 7750

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 7,750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit occurs when Selling Price (SP) is greater than the Cost Price (CP). Profit = SP − CP.

Profit Percentage

Profit % is always calculated on the base Cost Price unless stated otherwise. Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Selling Price Formula

To calculate the Selling Price directly with the gain percentage: SP = CP × (100 + Gain%) ÷ 100.
